title: Run Dataset Governance Agent through the advisory-only route
purpose: Implement the first canonical AD-011 competence as an independently useful advisory runtime: Dataset Governance Agent assesses one authorized candidate without persisting any Dataset field or entering generic MessageEnvelope/Safety/Bus/UI flow.
success_outcome: An explicit internal dataset_governance invocation constructs only DatasetGovernanceProviderRequestV1, validates DatasetGovernanceAssessmentV1, performs pre/post-I/O current authorization and candidate-version guards, returns the exact DatasetAgentRuntimeOutcomeV1 branch, appends exactly one redacted dataset_agent_runtime_decided event for every accepted attempt including context-denied/unbound/error, persists no Candidate field, and production remains unbound with no fake/fallback or generic MessageEnvelope effect.
anti_goals: Training Data Curator behavior, curator fields/gate, public endpoint/trigger, generic AgentRuntimeOutcomeV1 changes, MessageEnvelope/Safety/Bus/UI, provider selection, or lifecycle/trainability writes.
evidence_required: FT-014-AC-006 RED: the canonical roster identity exists but current ProviderExecutorBindings/composition has no Dataset Governance request/result route, so an explicit invocation is unsupported and produces no advisory outcome/event; GREEN: strict request/result and every outcome/audit branch execute with zero Candidate/MessageEnvelope/Safety/Bus/UI mutation; decisive comparison: spy input/calls, result/event matrix, post-I/O race rows and static forbidden-effect scan; artifact: focused deterministic/PostgreSQL transcript under .tasks/TASK-055-T3-FT-014-W2/.
constraints: runtime_route=dataset_advisory_v1 is immutable roster composition, not caller/model/config choice.
Provider I/O occurs outside DB transactions; current session/membership/Plant/grant/candidate locks repeat after I/O before any owning write, though this competence writes none.
Every accepted attempt tries the dedicated audit, including no-I/O denial and unbound production; audit failure returns no validated result/event.
invariants: Dataset Governance Agent assessment is untrusted advisory data and never mutable Dataset or Safety authority.
No production fake, canned result, fallback, credential lookup, provider/model/base URL selection, or network closure claim.
verification_targets: FT-014-AC-006: exact command/request/result allowlists, unknown/assignment rejection, success/context-denied/unbound/provider-failed/output-invalid/post-I/O-denied/audit-failed outcomes, event source/payload redaction and cardinality, archive/revoke/candidate-change races, zero Candidate writes, and zero generic publication effects.
